description.value: Fern Cafe and Bakery is a 100% vegan bakery cafe tucked into the Fernwood neighbourhood of Victoria, established in 2018 and owner-operated by a couple with over a decade of plant-based cooking experience. The menu leans into vegan comfort food — burgers, poutine, mac and cheese, fried chickun, all-day breakfast — alongside specialty pastries and espresso drinks made entirely in-house from scratch. Their famously oversized cinnamon buns and fresh-daily doughnuts have earned a strong local following, making it a worthwhile stop for plant-based touring cyclists passing through central Victoria.
